joi_block.name: Scenario
joi_block.script:
wait until((#Living_RVC).robotVacuumCleaner_robotVacuumCleanerOperatingState == "running")
wait until((#Living_RVC).robotVacuumCleaner_robotVacuumCleanerOperatingState == "docked") timeout(2 HOUR)
(#Living_Speaker).speaker_speak("The robot vacuum cleaner is stuck")

precision_reasoning: confirmed ir_gt + binding_gt; no NL mapping
command_kor: 로봇청소기가 청소를 시작하면, 2시간 안에 도킹하지 않으면 스피커로 '로봇청소기가 멈춰 있습니다'라고 알려줘.
command_eng: When the robot vacuum cleaner starts running, if it is not docked within 2 hours, announce 'The robot vacuum cleaner is stuck' through the speaker.

args.Text: The robot vacuum cleaner is stuck
